COREMERCH is a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that crafts customized digital commerce stacks for creators in restricted regions. By abandoning traditional payment gatekeepers, creators can now establish direct connections with their customers, sidestepping hefty transaction fees and onerous regulations. This is not a workaround; it's a fundamental redesign of the digital commerce landscape, one that puts creators, not intermediaries, at the helm.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, COREMERCH's solution relies on a combination of free and paid tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the creator's online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic, ensuring seamless order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 provides file storage, all managed by the creator themselves. NOWPayments, with its 300+ cryptocurrency options and 0.5% fee, handles on-chain payment verification, instantly notifying the creator upon successful transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in the Philippines and other regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. With COREMERCH, creators can now monetize their digital products with ease, unhindered by geographical or platform-based limitations. Whether selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, Filipino creators can now tap into a global market, unchained from the constraints of Stripe, PayPal, and other traditional payment gatekeepers.

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
NOWPayments, with its 300+ cryptocurrency options and 0.5% fee, offers seamless on-chain payment verification, instantly notifying creators upon successful transactions.
